subject: Biology
description: Auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ABA, ethylene — five plant hormones

questions.stem: AUXIN, the first plant hormone discovered, was first isolated from:

options.option_text: Tip of oat coleoptiles by Went

questions.explanation: AUXIN — discovered by F.W. WENT (1928) from oat (Avena) coleoptile tips, by his classic agar-block experiment. Charles Darwin + son (1880) first observed phototropism. Active form: IAA (indole-3-acetic acid). Functions: cell elongation, apical dominance (suppresses side branches), root initiation (rooting hormone for cuttings), parthenocarpy (seedless fruit). Synthetic auxins: 2,4-D (selective herbicide for broadleaf weeds), IBA, NAA. Distractor 1 = where cytokinin was found (Skoog).
questions.subject: Biology

questions.stem: GIBBERELLIN was first identified from a fungus that causes which disease in rice?

options.option_text: Blast disease, caused by other fungus
Brown spot disease, with leaf spots
Sheath blight, caused by yet another

questions.explanation: GIBBERELLINS — first identified in JAPAN (1926, Kurosawa) from the fungus GIBBERELLA fujikuroi, which causes BAKANAE (= 'foolish seedling') disease in rice. Infected rice grew abnormally TALL, weak, fell over. The fungal compound causing this was the first gibberellin (GA₃ = gibberellic acid). Functions: stem elongation, breaking dormancy in seeds, bolting (rapid flowering stem), enzyme induction in seeds. Used commercially to make seedless grapes larger.
questions.subject: Biology

questions.stem: The plant hormone responsible for FRUIT RIPENING (especially climacteric fruits like banana, mango, tomato) is:
questions.explanation: ETHYLENE (C₂H₄) — only GASEOUS plant hormone. Triggers fruit ripening: chlorophyll breakdown (green → yellow/red), starch → sugar, softening (cell wall enzymes activated). Why a ripe banana ripens others nearby — ethylene autocatalysis. CALCIUM CARBIDE (illegal in India under FSSAI) releases acetylene which mimics ethylene → forces unripe fruit to ripen artificially. ETHEPHON (commercial spray) releases ethylene controllably. Also induces leaf abscission, flower senescence.
questions.subject: Biology

questions.stem: ABSCISIC ACID (ABA) is sometimes called the 'STRESS HORMONE' because it:

options.option_text: Promotes vigorous growth in stress periods
Induces dormancy and closes stomata in stress
Aids ripening of all the climacteric fruits

questions.explanation: ABSCISIC ACID (ABA) — antagonist of GA + auxin. Induces seed + bud DORMANCY (allows survival through winter/drought). Closes STOMATA in water stress → reduces transpiration. Promotes leaf SENESCENCE + abscission (despite the name 'abscisic', not the major abscission player — ethylene is). Triggers tolerance to cold, salinity, drought. Crucial for desert plants. Distractor 1 — opposite of ABA. Distractor 4 = ethylene.
questions.subject: Biology

questions.stem: CYTOKININS are plant hormones that mainly promote:

options.option_text: Stem elongation and bolting in plants chiefly
Cell division and lateral bud growth in shoots
Fruit ripening and ageing in plant tissues

questions.explanation: CYTOKININS — name from CYTOKINESIS (cell division). Discovered by Skoog + Miller (1955) — KINETIN from herring sperm DNA; later ZEATIN from corn (Zea mays). Functions: promote CELL DIVISION (esp. in shoot/root meristems), break apical dominance (promote lateral / axillary bud growth — opposite of auxin), DELAY senescence (keep leaves green; 'rich-get-richer' effect — cytokinins from roots mobilise nutrients TO leaves they're sprayed on), with auxin determines shoot vs root in tissue culture (high CK : auxin → shoots; high auxin : CK → roots).
questions.subject: Biology

questions.stem: PHOTOTROPISM (plants bending TOWARD light) is caused by:

options.option_text: ABA collecting on lit shoot side
Auxin redistributing to the shaded side
Ethylene gas being released by stomata

questions.explanation: Phototropism — light causes auxin to MIGRATE to the SHADED side of the shoot. More auxin → more cell elongation on shaded side → shoot bends TOWARD light. CHOLODNY-WENT theory (1920s). Roots show NEGATIVE phototropism (bend away). Other tropisms: GEOTROPISM (gravity — roots positive, shoots negative), HYDROTROPISM (water — roots positive), THIGMOTROPISM (touch — tendrils coiling). Cryptochromes + phototropins are the photoreceptors.
questions.subject: Biology

questions.stem: Match: ROOTING HORMONE (used commercially to induce roots in plant cuttings) is a synthetic:
questions.explanation: Rooting hormone — synthetic AUXIN (most commonly IBA — Indole-3-Butyric Acid, or NAA — Naphthalene Acetic Acid). Auxin promotes ROOT INITIATION on stem cuttings. Sold as gel/powder/liquid. Cuttings from grape, rose, hibiscus, cassava commonly use it. Mechanism: auxin signals undifferentiated cells at cut surface to differentiate into root meristem. Also: 2,4-D = synthetic auxin used as broadleaf-WEED killer (excess kills broadleaf plants; spares grasses).
